checks.text: The page displays the heading "GPA Calculator" and, with no courses added, shows the text "No courses yet" and the summary line "GPA: 0.00".

Entering "Math 101" in the field labelled "Course Name", "4" in the field labelled "Credits", and "A" in the select labelled "Grade" then clicking "Add Course" adds a row to the table containing "Math 101", "4", "A", and "4.00"; the summary updates to "GPA: 4.00".
After adding "Physics 201" with "3" credits and grade "B", the table shows a row for "Physics 201" with "3", "B", and "3.00"; the summary updates to "GPA: 3.70".
Clicking "Add Course" with an empty "Course Name" field displays the error message "Course name is required" and does not add a row to the table.
Clicking the button labelled "Delete Math 101" removes that row from the table; the summary updates to "GPA: 3.00" and the table now only contains "Physics 201".

Clicking the tab labelled "Chart" switches the view to show a bar chart where the bar for "Math 101" has a height corresponding to 4.00 and the bar for "Physics 201" has a height corresponding to 3.00.
Clicking the button labelled "Copy GPA" copies the text "GPA: 3.70" to the clipboard.

Selecting "4.0" in the select labelled "Scale" changes the grade point for "A" to 4.0 and "B" to 3.0, keeping the GPA at "3.70"; selecting "5.0" changes the grade point for "A" to 5.0 and "B" to 4.0, updating the summary to "GPA: 4.25".
Reload keeps the added courses: after adding "Math 101" and "Physics 201", reloading the page still shows both rows in the table and the summary "GPA: 3.70".
